paper_metadata.title: The microstructure development in a Zr-enriched Ti–Zr–Al–Nb alloy during heat treatment for superior strength-ductility combination
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

evidence.quote: In this work, a Zr-enriched Ti – Zr – Al – Nb alloy was proposed and prepared.
In contrast to conventional titanium alloys, phase transformation was delayed due to the lattice distortion and diffusion retardation in the high-content Zr-enriched Ti – Zr alloy.
we proposed an alloy with 30 wt%Zr, 5 wt%Al, 5 wt%Nb and Ti bal.

A 15 kg ingot was prepared using the raw metals of Ti, Zr, Al and Nb with purities higher than 99.9% by vacuum magnetic levitation melting and casting.
After homogenization, the ingot was forged into a round rod with a diameter of ϕ 35 mm at temperature ranging from 950 ◦C to 830 ◦C.
Round bar samples with a size of ϕ 11mm × 70 mm were cut out of the rod using electro-discharge machine, and annealed at 875 ◦C/1h followed by furnace cooling.
